potential_convention: V=-mu_H2 HdaggerH-mu_S2 SdaggerS+lambda_H(HdaggerH)^2+lambda_S(SdaggerS)^2+lambda_HS(HdaggerH)(SdaggerS); H0=(vh+h)/sqrt(2), S=(vs+s)/sqrt(2), L contains -V

general_counterterm_map.hh: -dmu_H2 + 3 vh^2 dlambda_H + 6 lambda_H vh dvh + (vs^2/2) dlambda_HS + lambda_HS vs dvs
general_counterterm_map.ss: -dmu_S2 + 3 vs^2 dlambda_S + 6 lambda_S vs dvs + (vh^2/2) dlambda_HS + lambda_HS vh dvh
general_counterterm_map.hs: vh vs dlambda_HS + lambda_HS (vs dvh + vh dvs)

tadpole_map_at_tree_stationarity.delta_T_h_over_vh: -dmu_H2 + vh^2 dlambda_H + 2 lambda_H vh dvh + (vs^2/2) dlambda_HS + lambda_HS vs dvs
tadpole_map_at_tree_stationarity.delta_T_s_over_vs: -dmu_S2 + vs^2 dlambda_S + 2 lambda_S vs dvs + (vh^2/2) dlambda_HS + lambda_HS vh dvh
tadpole_map_at_tree_stationarity.identity_hh: delta_M_hh^2 - delta_T_h/vh = 2 vh^2 dlambda_H + 4 lambda_H vh dvh
tadpole_map_at_tree_stationarity.identity_ss: delta_M_ss^2 - delta_T_s/vs = 2 vs^2 dlambda_S + 4 lambda_S vs dvs

non_uniqueness: The three two-point matrix entries do not determine all quadratic, quartic, VEV, and tadpole counterterms. A tadpole/VEV prescription and the corresponding one-point functions are required before assigning unique renormalized potential-parameter counterterms.

fixed_vev_bookkeeping_basis.warning: This is one bookkeeping decomposition of the two-point UV pole. It does not fix the tadpole counterterms or define a VEV scheme.

scope: The matrix entries are UV-pole counterterm coefficients proportional to Delta_UV, not finite mass shifts.
The fixed-VEV decomposition is an algebraic example only, not a claim that this is the chosen MS-bar tadpole or VEV scheme.
No tadpole diagrams, VEV renormalization, complete scalar-potential beta functions, or gauge-complete self-energies are included.
